---
name: Support another hosting provider
about: Ask for GitLab, Forgejo/Gitea (Codeberg), Bitbucket, Azure DevOps or a self-hosted instance
title: "Provider: <name>"
labels: provider
---

**Which provider and host?**
For example gitlab.com, a self-managed GitLab at git.example.com, Codeberg, Bitbucket Cloud, Azure DevOps Services.

**What did everkeep print?**
Paste the "isn't supported yet" line, with the repository identity it showed (`gitlab:group/project`).

**What would you use it for?**
One repository or many, and which duties matter most (pull requests, vulnerabilities, dependencies, gaps).

**Can you help test it?**
A public project everkeep could read anonymously, or a test account you control. Never paste a token here.

The plan for adding providers, and what each adapter must do, is in `ai-docs/plans/providers-roadmap.md`.
